args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN
per FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but called
`quantize(..., rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)`. This change switches the
rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so `2.675 -> 2.68` and
`2.665 -> 2.66` as expected.

## Testing
- CI run on this branch: **passed** (commit 08d3cd5986, run ci-0001),
  including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
